reasoning: The upward blocky arrow over a horizontal bar is the standard symbol for uploading or submitting files. While uploading is an action, it is very frequently the core point of digital admin, work, and creative tasks (uploading documents to portals, pushing builds, backing up media). It slightly resembles a keyboard Shift/Caps Lock icon or a generic up arrow.

readings.meaning: export or back up to cloud

pass1.ambiguity: Can be mistaken for a keyboard Shift or Caps Lock key symbol, or a generic up arrow at very small sizes.
